name: Cane
description: A wooden cane, without any magical properties.

name: Decomposed Limb
description: The rotting limb of an undead creature

name: Eye of Ur
description: A gift from a distant world.

name: Rat Claws
description: Sharp, flea-ridden rodent claws capable of fast, pestilent scratches.

name: Serpent Jaws
description: The jaws of a slithering undead monster.

name: Sickle
description: A farming tool used to cut and trim

name: Spade
description: A simple tool used for farming

name: Spiked Skeleton
description: The skeleton of an undead monster, studded with very sharp spikes.

name: Stick
description: A crude wooden branch, barely shaped into a weapon. Every adventurer starts with one.

name: Training Bow
description: An inefficient bow used mainly for training

name: Algae
description: "Thin, greenish-brown plant that lives underwater. Its taste is salty and briny, and it's used mostly for exotic recipe typical of seaside settlements."

name: Ancient Eye
description: A gift from a nameless horror.

name: Apple
description: Round and glossy, with skin colors ranging from red to yellow. It’s crisp, juicy, and sweet, with a slight tartness.

name: Blueberry
description: Small and round, deep blue or purple in color. Usually found in the colder mountain trails, it has a slightly tart flavors, and leaves a mildly floral aftertaste.

name: Corrupted Dagger
description: A dagger of fine making, rendered useless by the curse of the Serpent.

name: Corrupted Shield
description: The integrity of this shield has been severely impaired by the curse of the Serpent.

name: Corrupted Staff
description: A staff built by expert hands, rendered useless by the curse of the Serpent.

name: Dreamcatcher
description: "An ancient accessory enhanced with a ritual by a long lost civilization. It's said to protect from evil spirits, and it provides a great experience gain boost to the wearer."

name: Grains
description: A small bag of dry kernels with various shapes and colors. They have a slightly chewy texture when cooked and a neutral, earthy flavor.

name: Leek
description: Long and cylindrical with pale green and white layers. Its flavor is mildly sweet, like a delicate cross between onions and garlic, with a crisp, firm texture.

name: Milk
description: White and smooth with a creamy consistency. It’s mild, slightly sweet, and soothing. Can be turned into many derivatives, used in a large amount of recipes.

name: Pear
description: With a smooth yellow skin, their flesh is soft, juicy, and sweet with a grainy texture that will melt in the mouth.

name: Potato
description: A starchy, oblong vegetable with a brown skin, considered a staple in the common villager diet. Its inside is soft, fluffy, and mildly earthy when cooked.

name: Rice
description: Tiny, white smooth grains that, when cooked, present a neutral taste and a soft texture. Often used as the main supply for soldiers embarked in long expeditions, as it is easy to conserve for long times.

name: Strawberry
description: Bright red, heart-shaped berries with tiny seeds on the outside, known to grow in the southern forests because of the warmer climate. It’s juicy and sweet, with a slightly tart edge.

name: Tomato
description: Round and smooth, with a bright yellow color. Its flesh is juicy and slightly sweet with a tart, refreshing flavor and soft seeds inside.

name: Upgrade: Effectiveness
description: Permanently increases Shelter auto-feed effectiveness by 10%.

name: Upgrade: Market Queue
description:
"Permanently increases Market's queue size by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

name: Upgrade: Market Time
description:
"Permanently reduces Market's sale times by 10%.
Limited to two purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

name: Upgrade: Quarters
description:
"Permanently increases Quarters capacity by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

name: Upgrade: Shelter
description:
"Permanently increases Shelter's capacity by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

name: Upgrade: Storage
description:
"Permanently increases Storage spaces by 1.
Limited to ten purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

name: Upgrade: Tavern Capacity
description:
"Permanently increases Tavern's capacity by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

name: Upgrade: Tavern Time
description:
"Permanently reduces Tavern's wait time by 10%.
Limited to two purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

name: Upgrade: Workshop Queue
description:
"Permanently increases Workshop's queue size by 1.
Limited to one purchase.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

name: Upgrade: Workshop Time
description:
"Permanently reduces Workshop's craft times by 10%.
Limited to two purchases.
This item will be consumed automatically upon buying it."

name: Wyvern Chop
description: Few people manage to take down a Wyvern, and even fewer manage to bite through its extremely hard meat. The taste is described as very intense, and the meat as extremely nutritious, with a single bite able to sustain a soldier for a day.

name: Banana
description: Yellow, sweet fruit found in tropical lands. Monkeys love them, even ones employed by the Skull Island fleet.

name: Egg
description: A smooth, oval shell encasing a firm white and a bright yellow yolk. When cooked, it becomes either soft and creamy or firm, with a mild, rich taste.

name: Meat Chop
description: "A thick, juicy cut of meat complete with a bone. It's the cheap, nutritious base for most meat based dishes."

name: Butter
description: A smooth, pale yellow spread that’s rich and creamy. It melts quickly, releasing a mild, slightly salty flavor with a hint of sweetness.

name: Pineapple
description: A spiky, golden-brown exterior hides bright yellow flesh. It’s juicy, tangy, and sweet with an exotic, refreshing flavor.

name: Spices
description: Colorful and aromatic, while not able to sate hunger by themselves, they can be added to a lot of recipes to emphasize their taste and appearance.

name: Meaty Mushroom
description: Soft and spongy with an earthy, mild flavor. Rarely found in the southern forests, where the damp climate sometimes allows for their growth.

name: Salt
description: "Small, white granules or crystals with a sharp, savory taste. While it's not advised to consume salt alone, it can enhance most recipes. It is also widely used to conserve foods."

name: Yoghurt
description: Creamy and smooth milk derivative. White in color, it’s tangy and slightly sour, with a rich, thick consistency that varies from silky to dense.

name: Vinegar
description: Slightly colored liquid with a sharp, pungent aroma. It delivers a sour, tangy taste that is perfectly suited for some of the more elaborate dishes.

name: Blueberry Pancake
description: A fluffy, golden-brown pancake dotted with juicy blueberries. It’s soft and sweet, with bursts of tart blueberry flavor in each bite.

name: Cheese
description: "Solid milk derivative, ranging in color from yellow to orange. Its flavor is sharp and salty, and it's used in many delicious recipes."

name: Strawberry Pancake
description: A light, fluffy pancake topped or filled with sweet strawberries imported from the southern forests. It’s soft and slightly sweet, with a fresh, juicy pop from the strawberries.

name: Fruit Salad
description: A colorful mix of fresh, juicy fruits, sweet and with a soft bite and a vibrant, refreshing flavor.

name: Potato Mash
description: "Smooth, creamy mashed potatoes with a buttery flavor. It's a simple dish enjoyed by every social class in the Realms."

name: Wooden Buckler
description: Round, lightweight shield made of wood

name: Chocolate
description: Exotic food that only the upper class citizen of the Capital can usually acquire. Melts on the tongue releasing sweet, slightly bitter, and complex cocoa flavors with a creamy finish.

name: Evo-22 Vial
description: A refined celestial compound that stimulates biological evolution. Permanently upgrades an adventurer's common trait into its enhanced PLUS form (Brute+, Feral+, Bookworm+).

name: Evo-23 Vial
description:
"A mysterious liquid employed by the Celestials to permanently enhance their soldiers' combat efficacy. It directly manipulates organic tissues, inducing extraordinary structural modifications.
This item can modify an adventurer rare trait."

name: Evo-23 Vial
description: This item can modify an adventurer rare trait.

name: Fresh salmon
description: A vibrant pink-orange fish with a firm, yet tender meat. Fished in the waters just above Blackwater Port, its taste is rich, buttery, and slightly sweet, with a moist, flaky texture when cooked.

name: Geode
description: Hollow rock that contains a precious gem. Rarely, they can contain a massive amount of gems.

name: Intercession
description:
"Allows an Adventurer to ascend without resetting their level.

Ascended adventurers gain access to Doctrines, increased base stats and an increased potion limits, but require twice the experience to level up."

name: Potion of Agility
description: Permanently increases Dodge Chance by 1% (additive).

name: Potion of Darkness
description: Permanently increases damage by [0.1 × Darkness] %.

name: Potion of Defense
description: Permanently increases Defense by 1.

name: Potion of Dexterity
description: Permanently increases Dexterity by 1.

name: Potion of Health
description: Permanently increases HP by 5.

name: Potion of Immunity
description: Permanently increases Status Immunity by 1%.

name: Potion of Intelligence
description: Permanently increases Intelligence by 1.

name: Potion of Magic Defense
description: Permanently increases Magic Defense by 1.

name: Potion of Precision
description: Permanently increases Critical Hit Chance by 1%.

name: Potion of Viciousness
description: Permanently increases Critical Damage by 2%.

name: Red Reaper
description: A small, wrinkled red pepper with a sinister appearance. Its taste is fiery and incredibly spicy, leaving a sharp, lingering heat on the tongue.

name: Wooden Bow
description: A simple bow made of flexible wood

name: Bread
description: "A soft, golden-brown crust gives way to a fluffy, airy interior. It's one of the most common foods in the Realms, enjoyed by paesants, soldiers and nobles alike."

name: Coffee
description: Deep brown liquid with a strong, earthy aroma. Nutritional content is close to zero, but allows for cooking delicious recipes.

name: Fresh Tuna
description: Deep red, firm flesh that’s meaty and dense. Valuable fish rarely found in the high seas, it has a clean, mild flavor with a slight hint of salt.

name: Pumpkin
description: Vibrantly orange with smooth, firm flesh. They grow only in the upper caverns below the Gates of Hell, thriving in the Nexus artificial light.

name: Tusk Necklace
description: Simple ornament made with boar tusks.

name: Fang Dagger
description: A dagger made with a huge wolf fang in place of the blade.

name: Mushroom Omelette
description: A fluffy, golden omelette filled with tender mushrooms. It’s soft and savory, with a rich flavor and a slightly creamy texture.

name: Salmon Nigiri
description: A slice of fresh, bright orange salmon atop a small bed of rice wrapped in seaweed. A staple dish in the diet of sailors, pirates and sea merchants.

name: Avocado
description: It has a smooth, dark green skin with a creamy, buttery flesh inside. It’s mild and rich in fats, with a subtle, nutty flavor. Complements some of the most exotic, fish based recipes.

name: Copper Armor
description: A heavy armor made of copper held together with leather straps.

name: Copper Axe
description: A simple axe forged from copper, sturdy enough to fell timber and foes alike.

name: Dino Ribs
description: Massive, meaty ribs with a thick, tender texture. Packed with protein, they make a hearty meal, but the ancient beasts they come from are incredibly challenging to hunt.

name: Iron Sword
description: A standard iron sword commonly used throughout the Realms.

name: Perch
description: A freshly caught perch. Pets love the taste.

name: Salad
description: A simple mix of crisp leeks and colorful tomatoes. It’s light, crunchy, and refreshing, but not one of the most nutritious dishes.

name: Sauce
description: A smooth, liquid or semi-liquid mixture derived from tomatoes, leek and a bit of salt. It adds moisture, richness, and depth to dishes.

name: Cookie
description: Golden and slightly crispy chocolate sweet with a soft, chewy center. A refined food destined to the breakfast of nobles, ambassadors and rich merchants.

name: Sweet and Sour Meat
description: Tender meat chunks coated in a glossy, reddish sauce and pineapple pieces. The flavor is a perfect balance of tangy sweetness and a mild sour kick.

name: Exotic fruit Salad
description: Complemented with pineapple pieces, this fruit salad is juicy, sweet, and tangy, offering a burst of tropical flavors.

name: Stew
description: A warm, hearty mixture of slow-cooked ingredients. It’s thick and comforting, with tender chunks of vegetables suspended in broth.

name: Copper Helmet
description: Regular helmet made with copper for some extra protection.

name: Pasta
description: Long spaghetti derived from grains, a common food found in many towns and villages. It provides a satisfying, slightly chewy texture and can be perfected with sauce.

name: Steak Braisé
description: A slow-cooked, tender steak with a deep brown exterior. It’s rich and flavorful, with a slightly smoky taste.

name: Potion of Rejuvenation
description:
"Resets an adventurer to its base rank, preserving ascension status.
This potion should be used to correct mistakes when choosing a class branch. This is not a prestige mechanic, but an Adventurer reset."

name: Spirit Tome
description: Otherworldly book found in possession of an ethereal being. Tells of tales from another plane, giving insight into different forms of magic.

name: Tuna Nigiri
description: Deep red tuna on rice, firm yet tender, wrapped in seaweed. A delicacy sometimes found in the diet of pirates and wealthy sea merchants.

name: Leather Boots
description: Common footwear made of leather

name: Silver Ring
description: A simple ring made of silver.

name: Grilled Cheese
description: Golden, crispy bread surrounds melted, gooey cheese. The sandwich is warm and rich, with a satisfying crunch and a creamy, salty interior.

name: Wurmscales Boots
description: Sturdy boots made with wurm scales.

name: Meat Pie
description: A golden, flaky pastry crust surrounds a savory filling of tender meat. It’s warm, hearty, and packed with robust, meaty flavors.

name: Skeleton Key
description: "A strange key adorned with a skull handle. It's very cold to the touch. Looks infused with a powerful curse that amplifies one's power over death."

name: Wurmscales Shield
description: Round, light shield made from wurm scales.

name: Blue Trout
description: A blue trout pulled from the Slumbering Shallows.

name: Wurmscales Gloves
description: Sturdy gloves made with wurm scales.

name: Blueberry Smoothie
description: A thick, purple blend of blueberries and creamy ingredients. This recipe is not commonly found, as the few blueberries brought back from the troll ridden mountains were reserved for kings and princes.

name: Infused Necklace
description: Necklace infused with a glowing liquid to confer it additional properties. Provides a small experience gain boost to the wearer.

name: Strawberry Smoothie
description: A pink, creamy drink bursting with sweet, juicy strawberries. A common, albeit expensive recipe before the corruption struck, when the southern forests creatures were shy and peaceful.

name: Iron Helm
description: The most common helm worn by regular soldiers.

name: Spell Compendium
description: A rare book given only to the most powerful Laroxian mages, contains all kinds of spells discovered by their people.

name: Frozen Breath Broth
description: A cold, misty soup with an icy, translucent appearance. The broth helps to make the Wyvern meat more tender, but chewing it is still a daunting task for many.

name: Leather Gloves
description: Basic gloves made of leather.

name: Scimitar
description: "Sword with a peculiar, recurve blade used by the Sha'huri people of the Desert."

name: Meat Stew
description: A warm, hearty mixture of slow-cooked ingredients. Tender chunks of meat float along with vegetables in the broth.

name: Undead Helm
description: Helm made with undead remains. Offers more protection than more traditional ones.

name: Cheese Risotto
description: Creamy, soft rice infused with melted cheese. It tastes mildly salty, with a smooth consistency.

name: Enchanted Staff
description: "An ancient seed from an Ent makes this staff a bit attuned to the holder's magic."

name: Fullmoon Dagger
description: Dagger that uses the tooth of a wolf as a blade. However, this particular tooth seems to exhibit some weird properties.

name: Glazed Donut
description: A soft, fluffy ring of dough coated in a glossy, sugary glaze. Popular among the north-eastern settlers, the exact recipe is not known.

name: Leather Jacket
description: A simple jacket made of leather.

name: Wurmscales Jacket
description: Made with wurm scales for increased integrity, padded with feathers.

name: Salmon Roll
description: "A sushi roll with soft rice, avocado and fresh salmon. Hard to make since ingredients must be imported from very distant areas, it's considered a delicacy even in the richest cities."

name: Angelfish
description: A delicate angelfish, perfect for pampered pets.

name: Hellish Rations
description: A dark, revolting soup with an eye floating in it. You can’t tell if the eye fell in by accident or if it’s part of the recipe. It looks vile, and there’s only one way to find out if it will kill you.

name: Iron Axe
description: A dependable iron axe, widely used by woodsmen and recruits across the Realms.

name: Apple Pie
description: A golden, flaky crust surrounds a soft, spiced apple filling. It’s sweet and slightly tart, with cinnamon adding warmth to the juicy, tender apples.

name: Iron Chainmail
description: Iron rings woven together to confer basic protection in battle.

name: Pear Pie
description: A buttery, golden crust holds a soft, sweet pear filling. The pears are tender and juicy, with a delicate sweetness and subtle spiced aroma.

name: Undead Shield
description: Large shield made with undead remains.

name: Cloth Robe
description: A light robe made of cloth derived from plants.

name: Mushroom Stew
description: A warm, earthy dish filled with tender mushrooms. The broth is thick and flavorful, with a slightly spongy texture.

name: Tuna Roll
description: "A sushi roll made with red tuna, avocado and rice. Hard to make since ingredients must be imported from very distant areas, it's considered a delicacy even in the richest cities."

name: Undead Knife
description: A dagger made with a long, sharpened undead rib.

name: Undead Sword
description: A grim sword made with undead remains.

name: Glass Knife
description: A sharp dagger with an edge made of glass.

name: Mascarpone Cheese
description: Smooth, creamy, and white with a rich, buttery texture. It has a mild, slightly sweet taste and a velvety consistency that melts easily.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy rice with tender Meaty Mushrooms. A very esteemed dish, given the difficulty of importing this kind of mushrooms in the northern cities even prior to the corruption.

name: Pasta with Sauce
description: Long spaghetti derived from grains, a common food found in many towns and villages, coated in a bright red sauce.

name: Skull Candle
description: An unextinguishable, grim lantern fused to the skull of a great warrior, still alive but harmless in this condition.

name: Winged Ray
description: A gliding ray catch with firm, meaty flesh.

name: Feather Robe
description: A light robe made of feathers, displaying the color of the desert birds.

name: Undead Cuirass
description: Heavy chest armor made from undead remains.

name: Undead Jacket
description: Grim piece of equipment made with undead remains. Offers good protection against external attacks maintaining some mobility.

name: Undead Axe
description: A jagged axe fashioned from shapeless bone and grisly remains.

name: Undead Gloves
description: Gloves made with undead remains. A little too sticky, but allows for a good range of movements.

name: Undead Greaves
description: Sturdy footwear made from undead remains.

name: Taco
description: A crunchy bread slice filled with meat, cheese, and sauces. It’s savory and nutritious, with a mix of different textures.

name: Red Reaper Sauce
description: "A fiery, bright red sauce with an intense, lingering heat. It’s incredibly spicy, not very nutritious by itself and it's highly recommended to not eat this alone."

name: "Sha'huri Bow"
description:
"A bow made with a process known only to the people of the desert. Arrows shot with it can rarely stun their target.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

name: Shadow Ring
description: A silver ring with an inset Shadow Gem. Grants superior reflexes.

name: Undead Staff
description: Made with undead remains, allows for some control over the flow of magic forces.

name: Avian Egg
description: Egg that will hatch an Avian pet. Avian pets usually like to attract enemy attention, distracting them from the party.

name: Construct Egg
description: Egg that will hatch a pet Construct. Constructs usually like to use magic to impair enemies and illuminate dark areas.

name: Esoteric Egg
description: Egg that will hatch an Esoteric pet. Esoteric pets like to provide indirect bonuses, like granting enhanced learning, or finding more items.

name: Flute
description: A finely crafted flute, the work of master artisans from the Golden City.

name: Gourmet Icecream
description: "An experimental way of serving a cold , sweet flavoured cream. It's a rare speciality only a few select food lovers ever had a chance to taste."

name: Insect Egg
description: Egg that will hatch a pet Insect. Insects usually like to attack enemies, and grant damage reduction.

name: Mythic Egg
description: A legendary egg infused with ancient power. It shimmers with otherworldly energy, holding mythical beasts of legend within.

name: Potion of Constitution
description: Permanently increases Constitution by 1.

name: Reptile Egg
description: Egg that will hatch a pet Reptile. Reptiles usually enhance the team offensive capabilities.

name: Wild Egg
description: Egg that will hatch a Wild pet. Wild pets usually provide strategic support to the team, enhancing health management and offensive capabilities.

name: Wooden Egg
description: Egg that will hatch a Wooden pet. Wooden pets like to help the team stay alive, and are rarely keen for harming enemies.

name: XP Book (Tier 1)
description: Grants 10 experience to an adventurer.

name: Blue Shark
description: A hefty blue shark — a true feast for any pet.

name: Redwood Bow
description: Resistant bow made of redwood, a light and flexible material imported from far away.

name: Deviled Eggs
description: Halved boiled eggs with a yolk filling. The filling is extremely spicy, so this dish is not for every palate.

name: Spectral Robe
description: Cloak made with mysterious, ethereal fabric of unknown origin.

name: Metamorphic Shield
description: Spikes will come out from this shield when needed, to hurt foes that get too close.

name: Emerald Ring
description: A silver ring with an inset emerald, a precious stone carrying some magical properties of protective nature.

name: Ruby Ring
description: A silver ring with an inset ruby, a precious stone carrying some magical properties of protective nature.

name: Ghastly Shield
description: "Shield made on skulls and bones infused with a spectral essence of uncertain origin. Its own will is able to harm melee attackers in ways they can't conceive."

name: Heaven and Hell
description: The epitome of experimental, nouvelle cuisine. A taco using the hard Wyvern meat as filling, completed with the hottest sauce in the realms. A unique experience for sure, but definitely not for everyone.

name: Ghostwood Shield
description: Shield made of ancient, refined ghostwood planks.

name: Winter Boots
description: Extremely durable boots made with materials found in high altitudes. Confer extra regeneration to the wearer due to the Troll skin present in their weave.

name: Silk Robe
description: Garment made with precious fabric, provides little protection but grants a wide range of movements.

name: Maxxiburger
description: A massive, towering burger with layers of juicy meat, melted cheese, crisp lettuce, and savory sauces. Not very healthy, but extremely caloric.

name: Living Scimitar
description: A living weapon imbued with the spirit of a Djinn. Will sometimes act on its own, showing incredible mastery.

name: Golden Gauntlets
description: Gauntlets made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantry and archers.

name: Djinn Tonic
description: A vial filled with the spirit of a slain Djinn. You do sometimes wonder whether it enjoys being a tasty drink, but the remarkable benefits of a sip now and then easily overshadow any ethical concerns.

name: Tortoise Shield
description: Heavy, resistant shield made from giant tortoise shells.

name: Verdant Blade
description: An unusual dagger with a Spitfang tooth instead of a blade.

name: Ghostwood Bow
description: Resilient bow made of ghostwood. The flexibility of this wood makes it possible to shoot arrows with a greater strength.

name: Winterwood Staff
description: The peculiar properties of the material allows for good magic attunement, making it a prized possession among spellcasters.

name: Corrupted Axe
description: An Enforcer's axe, warped by a dark corruption that devours the light.

name: Obsidian Shield
description: Big, heavy shield made in obsidian. Offers a degree of protection vastly superior than the more common ones.

name: Winter Shield
description: Very hard but light shield made with metal and wood only found at very high altitudes.

name: Winter Gloves
description: Gloves that can boost the regeneration of wounds thanks to the oils impregnating their inner side.

name: Obsidian Helm
description: A thick helm made of obsidian, extremely hard to break with conventional weapons.

name: Winterwood Bow
description: Superior bow made with the elusive winterwood, shoots arrows with very high strength and precision.

name: Black Iron Gauntlets
description: Gauntlets made of disjointed plates of Black Iron.

name: Ascended Bow
description:
"The power of thunder has been infused into this bow, to enhance its disruptive capabilities.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

name: Black Iron Helm
description: Resistant helm made with Black Iron.

name: Molten Staff
description: A poorly contained fire magic engine allows mages to channel their powers through this staff, albeit inaccurately.

name: Spitfang Jacket
description: "Made entirely with Spitfang's scales and padded with fabric made by Moth wings. Will allow for great mobility while offering extremely good protection."

name: Magma Shark
description: A steaming magma shark — an incredibly rich feed.

name: Pastel de Belém
description: A traditional Portuguese custard tart in a crisp, flaky puff pastry, lightly dusted with cinnamon and sugar. A beloved delicacy that pets find irresistible.

name: Obsidian Dagger
description: Extremely sharp weapon with a blade in Obsidian.

name: Trollskin Jacket
description: Hard as stone while allowing for a wide range of movements, secretes an oil that hastens the healing of wounds.

name: Belt Jacket
description: Crafted from the belts in use by the Golden City Wardens, this equipment is surprisingly resilient despite its improvised nature.

name: Elastic Boots
description: Sewn together using a mysterious membrane, almost unbreakable but able to be stretched beyond ordinary limits.

name: Golden Boots
description: Boots made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantry and archers.

name: Obsidian Scepter
description: "Perfectly balanced scepter sculpted from obsidian, offers minimal resistance to the owner's flow of magic."

name: Obsidian Sword
description: A double edged sword made with the sharpest stone. Can inflict terrible wounds with one swing.

name: Obsidian Bow
description: "Sculpted from a single obsidian block, this unusual bow's weight is even more balanced than the classical, wooden ones."

name: Black Iron Scepter
description: Crafted with the most popular iron variation among the pirates, this staff is well balanced and allows magic to flow within with little resistance.

name: Frozen Egg Pendant
description: Encapsulates an authentic Frozen Wivern egg. Every ice damage inflicted by the owner will be amplified by the unborn creature still living inside.

name: Black Iron Dagger
description: "Knife made with the pirate's Black Iron."

name: Cottontail Jacket
description: Simple jacket padded with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur.

name: Crystal Staff
description: Built from the remains of an Ice Elemental, this superior staff has the additional property of making the holder resistant to harmful statuses.

name: Obsidian Axe
description: A razor-sharp axe knapped from a single block of volcanic glass.

name: Black Iron Cutlass
description: A curved blade commonly wielded by Skull Island pirates.

name: Golden Helm
description: Helm made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantrymen.

name: Verdant Helm
description: Helm made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.

name: Abyssal Compendium
description: A book listing forgotten techniques of spellweaving, learned from eldritch entities at a great price.

name: Crystal Dagger
description: With a blade derived from an original Frost Crystal, inflicts tremendous damage when striking vulnerable points.

name: Spider Boots
description: Thanks to the peculiar fabric from which they have been woven, those who wear them can move with extraordinary agility.

name: Spider Gloves
description: Made from the coveted Giant Spider silk, these gloves allow for superior mobility without sacrificing the safety of the wearer.

name: Winter Helm
description: Very hard helm made with uncommon materials, can withstand blows otherwise fatal.

name: Black Iron Axe
description: A heavy axe hewn from black iron, reinforced with spectral wood.

name: Ghost Rabbit Cloak
description: Light cloak made from ghastly fabric mixed with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur.

name: Laroxian Gloves
description: Light and resistant gloves woven from a magic infused cloth produced in Larox, and padded with a magical cloth.

name: Exotic Boots
description: Durable but comfortable boots made with soft velvet.

name: Obsidian Cuirass
description: Very heavy chest armor that grants the wearer with the highest levels of protection.

name: Golden Shield
description: Shield made of gold, worn by the Imperial Army infantrymen.

name: Ghastly Scimitar
description: With a consciousness enhanced by undead spirits, this living sword reacts with heightened speed.

name: Black Iron Armor
description: "Very hard plates made with the pirate's Black Iron make this armor difficult to break."

name: Tiramisù
description: "A layered dessert with creamy mascarpone and espresso-soaked cookies. It has a smooth and sweet taste, and it's extremely nutritious."

name: Dreamwrought Jacket
description: Jacket assembled from materials dreamt by an otherworldly being. Sacrifices defense to grant a superior mobility to the wearer.

name: Celestial Helmet
description: Helmet crafted from a metal not from this world. Offers higher standards of protection than any alloy made from ordinary metals.

name: Elastic Robe
description: An unknown light, elastic material sewn in the shape of a robe. Offers great protection, without hindering the wearer mobility, which is vital for spellcasting.

name: Laroxian Boots
description: Light and resistant boots woven from a magic infused cloth produced in Larox, and padded with a magical cloth.

name: Cheesecake
description: A creamy, dense dessert with a smooth, rich texture. Tastes incredibly good, and pets love this.

name: Frostmetal Dagger
description: Dagger made with the coldest Frostmetal.

name: Mitre Hat
description: A head covering traditionally worn by the Golden City priests. This hat, blessed with an ancient ritual exclusive to their creed, amplifies all healing spells cast by the wearer.

name: Ancient Boots
description: Boots sewn together using the resistant and flexible hide of prehistoric giants.

name: Ancient Gloves
description: Gloves sewn together using the resistant and flexible hide of prehistoric giants.

name: Banshee Gloves
description: Made from Banshee scales grafted together. Allows for superior protection while granting a great range of movements.

name: Animated Helm
description: Helm made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

name: Celestial Shield
description: Shield crafted from a metal not from this world. Offers higher standards of protection than any alloy made from ordinary metals.

name: Verdant Boots
description: Boots made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.

name: Golden Sword
description: Superior swords issued to the Imperial Army infantry.

name: Golden Axe
description: A gleaming axe of pure gold, a symbol of wealth and crushing authority.

name: Winter Cape
description: "The peculiar properties of the troll's Wintercloth allows to craft this very light albeit resilient light clothing"

name: Tortoise Armor
description: Heavy armor made with the thick, resilient shell of a large tortoise.

name: Verdant Gloves
description: Gloves made of a rare, extremely resilient type of wood. Keeps sprouting new leaves that have to be periodically trimmed by the owner.

name: Animated Buckler
description: Round shield made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

name: "Dryad's Curse"
description: With a resilient Dryad hair running upon its edge, this weapon can cut through defensive spells like an axe through butter.

name: Frostmetal Armor
description: The hardest frostmetal coupled with trollskin paddings give this armor an extreme durability, while gifting the wearer with an increased regeneration.

name: Laroxian Robe
description: Light and versatile robe woven from a magic infused cloth produced in Larox.

name: Frostmetal Sword
description: Thick, heavy sword made from the coldest Frostmetal.

name: Frostmetal Axe
description: An axe cast from frostmetal, cold to the touch and ringing like winter wind.

name: Spider Robe
description: Made entirely with Giant Spider silk, whose elasticity and resistance is unparalleled.

name: Sylvan Flute
description: An intricate flute, fashioned with a mysterious technique by the reclusive dryads of the Southern Grove.

name: Banshee Dagger
description: Short knife build from a Banshee claw, which takes advantage of the very sharp edge to inflict tremendous damage.

name: Golden Armor
description: Standard, high quality equipment issued to the Empire Army soldiers.

name: Arcane Dagger
description: Exclusive blade gifted from the Seer to its assassins, able to pierce even the thickest steel.

name: Burning Censer
description: An otherworldly candle encased in a metal support, anointed with oils that display healing properties.

name: Imperial Shield
description: Decorated kite shield employed by the higher generals of the Empire Army. Engineered by the best blacksmiths to provide the highest standards of protection.

name: Imperial Staff
description: "A staff traditionally held by the powerful Imperial Mages, working with the Empire's army. Only the best pieces from the Golden City artisans make it to the battlefield."

name: Living Whip
description:
"An unconventional weapon made with improvised materials, after careful research about the nature of the mysterious Dryad's hairs. Taunts enemies on hit for one turn, and has much greater range than the regular melee weapons.
TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target"

name: Nightwing Jacket
description: Made with a type of leather that comes from giant bats rarely found in very deep caverns, allows for superior mobility and protection.

name: Celestial Sword
description: Sword made from an alien alloy, with a durability above every known material.

name: Ancient Jacket
description: Extremely versatile jacket made with the remains of prehistoric giants.

name: Ancient Robe
description: Extremely light robe made with the remains of a prehistoric wing.

name: Verdant Bow
description: Made of the finest wood in the Realms, this bow can withstand an extreme tension without ever breaking.

name: Animated Dagger
description: Dagger made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

name: Celestial Axe
description: An axe of alien alloy, impossibly light and keen.

name: Slime Armor
description: Protective armor made with sticky, green slime that can dissipate the force of any impact, lowering their effectiveness.

name: Slime Jacket
description: Dissipate the force of incoming blows very effectively, but sacrifices some mobility.

name: Slime Robe
description: Peculiar light equipment that sacrifices mobility to grant increased protection.

name: Wyvern Cape
description: Enhanced with real Snow Wyvern scales, this robe allows for an enhanced channeling of white magic.

name: Animated Staff
description: Staff made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

name: Animated Sword
description: Sword made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

name: Animated Bow
description: Bow made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

name: Panopticon Staff
description: "Aligned Beholder irises allows for the dispersion of light from the caster's spells to be focused with a constructive interference, producing a large amount of light."

name: Patrician Armor
description: A golden armor adorned with the elusive Golden Rabbit fur, worn in social occasions by high ranking generals and diplomats.

name: Celestial Armor
description: Armor made with alien Celestial Metal. Its superior properties grant an increase in protection from almost any armor crafted with metals found in the Realms.

name: Toxin Pouch
description: A small bag holding an extract from the flesh of a poisonous mushroom. While too weak to act on its own, it enhances existing poisons by introducing an additional mechanism of action.

name: Ignition Orb
description: A river of Aether dances and twists in beautiful patterns inside the orb, contained by a powerful magic. Any caster with a good experience in the field of fire magic can tap into the Aether contained within to increase the temperature of their flames.

name: Banshee Jacket
description: "Made of resilient Banshee scales, one of the hardest known organic materials that can bend enough to not reduce the wearer's mobility too much."

name: Animated Axe
description: Axe made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

name: Primeval Shield
description: Shield made from the scale of an enormous creature, capable of withstanding the hardest blows without breaking.

name: Ivory Jacket
description: Belt jacket enhanced with precious Ivory.

name: Dreamwrought Robe
description: An ethereal robe woven from cloth dreamt by an otherworldly being. Sacrifices resistance to grant a better intelligence improvement.

name: Short Circuit
description:
"Able to reproduce electric magic without tapping into any magic source. Will be thrown at a random enemy at the end of the turn, dealing damage and having a small chance to STUN them.
STUN: the unit skips its turn."

name: "Dryad's Blessing"
description: An average staff when considering its offensive potential, this intricate weapon really shines in the hands of an experienced healer.

name: Spellwoven Jacket
description: Jacket made from a very resistant type of leather, produced by magical means.

name: Mithril Helm
description: An incredibly light and resistant helm crafted from the legendary Mithril.

name: Animated Cuirass
description: Heavy armor made from Animated Metal, pulsating in a pale blue light.

name: Moth Robe
description: Resistant but very light robe made from the wings of a Giant Moth.

name: Dreamwrought Boots
description: "Made from a material dreamt and materialized by an otherworldly entity, these boots display surprising properties that can't be replicated with ordinary matter."

name: Shielding Helm
description: Helm enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.

name: Archaic Amulet
description: "A fiery gem embedded in this pendant attracts wildlife, enhancing the holder's empathy and connection with animals they're close with. Grants Animal Affinity, which increases the damage of living creatures controlled by 1% for each point."

name: Mithril Shield
description: An incredibly light and resistant shield crafted from the legendary Mithril.

name: Monkey Hide Jacket
description: Very flexible and resilient armor made with monkey hides.

name: Crimson Leech
description: Corrupted with an otherworldly force bound by an alchemist through forbidden rituals, grants the holder a fragment of the power of the Unholy Serpent.

name: Spiked Tortoise Shield
description: A shield made with a Giant Tortoise shell with spikes attached, offers great defensive capabilities while hurting melee attackers with its razor sharp spikes.

name: Focused Scepter
description: "A magic staff built with an alien alloy, integrated with an organic construct able to focalize the energy released into a ray as thin as a hair. While not as powerful as many alternatives, this staff completely nullifies any dispersion of the caster's energy."

name: Ceremonial Dagger
description: A blade crafted for the ancient rituals of the mountain Trolls. While its combat effectiveness is far inferior to that of a simple dagger, a lingering spell imbued in the weapon grants it power in other, more mystical ways.

name: Armor of the Dryad
description: Incorporates a single, long Dryad hair that works as a powerful, permanent healing spell.

name: Dreamwrought Gloves
description: "Made from a material dreamt and materialized by an otherworldly entity, these gloves display surprising properties that can't be replicated with ordinary matter."

name: Dreamwrought Staff
description: Ethereal staff made from an impossible metal, brought to reality by an otherworldly being.

name: Kaunian Robe
description: Extremely resistant robe woven from cloth employed by Kaunis elite troops. Grants increased protection to the wearer, but the lack of magic used in its making will reduce the boost to intelligence.

name: Fleetfoot Jacket
description: Jacket padded with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.

name: Enforcer's Axe
description: A once-corrupted axe, purified and marked with the imperial seal.

name: Robe of the Archmage
description: A robe enchanted with powerful protection spells, usually worn by members of the High Council of Larox.

name: Skin Blender
description: Glove that replicates the dreaded Banshee strike. Will cut through your foes like a knife through water, inflicting tremendous damage with each strike

name: Mithril Dagger
description: An incredibly light and resistant dagger crafted from the legendary Mithril.

name: Unstable Staff
description: Magic staff that draws its power from an arcane gem of unpredictable behaviour. The energy released will vary greatly without a known pattern.

name: Fleetfoot Boots
description: Boots made with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.

name: Vampire Dagger
description: With an extremely sharp blade, has been enhanced to draw energy from wounded enemies.

name: Ambrosia
description: "A golden ethereal drink, extremely sweet and with a caloric intake which is off the charts. The way it's produced is unknown, but is sometimes carried from unknown lands by the traveling merchants."

name: XP Book (Tier 2)
description: Grants 100 experience to an adventurer.

name: Mithril Sword
description: An incredibly light and resistant sword crafted from the legendary Mithril.

name: Primeval Helm
description: Helm made from the scale of an enormous creature, capable of withstanding the hardest blows without breaking.

name: Mithril Bow
description: An incredibly light and resistant bow crafted from the legendary Mithril.

name: Vampire Scepter
description: "Enhanced with a peculiar brew, empowers the holder's magic with the ability to return from the target as a healing force."

name: Vampire Sword
description: An Obsidian Sword that gained the ability to draw energy from enemies, restoring the holder HP.

name: Fleetfoot Gloves
description: Gloves made with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.

name: Vampire Bow
description: Alchemic result of a long research, its arrows can draw energy from the wounds inflicted and heal the owner for a part of it.

name: Vampire Axe
description: An obsidian axe steeped in a crimson brew that saps the vitality of those it wounds.

name: Dreamwrought Bow
description: Flexible bow made from an impossible metal frame, brought to reality by an otherworldly being.

name: Ancient Armor
description: Extremely durable armor made with the hardest known metal, lined with remains of prehistoric giants.

name: Celestial Mercy
description: A Celestial Sword imbued with a fluid typically used as fuel for advanced Celestial ships. When ignited, the fluid emits a bright light but does not harm the blade, thanks to the unique metal of its construction. Deals damage in a broader area, landing hits even when they should miss.

name: Wicked Scepter
description: A horrible weapon instinctively repelling all living beings, though no one can explain the cause of this feeling. When the wielder summons a minion, this staff will summon a powerful accessory bound to it.

name: Tactical Helmet
description: An alien helmet that integrates unknown technology to provide the wearer with far more information that the naked eye can perceive.

name: Metamorphic Armor
description: Shapeshifting spikes poke out from this armor when needed, orienting themselves towards attackers.

name: Shielding Jacket
description: Padded jacket enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.

name: Shielding Cuirass
description: Heavy armor enhanced with an endless source of magic power, to shield the user from external influences.

name: Dreamwrought Armor
description: Heavy armor made from a metal dreamt by a powerful being. Its ethereal nature makes it less hard than its alternatives, but allows far more mobility.

name: Abyssal Greataxe
description: A colossal greataxe forged in the abyss, its edge drinks the light.

name: Fleetfoot Armor
description: Heavy armor padded with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.

name: Orichalcum Dagger
description: An extremely sharp blade crafted from an unbreakable metal from another world.

name: Primeval Armor
description: Armor plated with the scales of an enormous behemoth, extremely heavy but capable of withstanding devastating blows.

name: Shadow Dagger
description: A blade drawn by darkness, turns its owner into a dangerous night hunter.

name: Exotic Robe
description: Woven with Velvet imported by pirates, these robes are sought after by all the mages and nobles in the highest spheres.

name: Shadow Bow
description: Infused with a Shadow Potion, this bow grants its owner the feats of a nocturnal predator.

name: Cursed Jacket
description: Made with an ancient metal with unique properties, makes deep wounds inflicted by the wearer hurt even more.

name: Orichalcum Shield
description: Made from a metal seemingly impossible to destroy, this shield offers unmatched protection to the wearer.

name: Orichalcum Sword
description: A large sword made from Orichalcum, an unbreakable metal from another world.

name: Frozen Long Axe
description: A long axe sheathed in rime, freezing whatever it strikes.

name: Unholy Sword
description: "Antithesis to all that is holy, will inflict damage to any enemy entering it's malevolent aura."

name: Spiked Primeval Shield
description: An incredibly bulky shield made with the scales of a giant behemoth, can cause considerable damage to any attacker through the sharp tortoise spikes attached.

name: Unholy Axe
description: An obsidian axe desecrated by an unholy potion, turning enemy strikes against them.

name: Sun Staff
description: "A fire artifact has been isolated into the staff's head, granting its wielder a better control on fire magic."

name: Bleak Gloves
description: Gloves made from unknown materials, glowing with an evil light and blessed by an ancient power.

name: Unholy Cuirass
description: The malignant aura surrounding this armor will harm any enemies daring to enter its range.

name: Ghastly Cuirass
description: Heavy chest armor infused with an otherworldly substance, able to attract the enemies attention.

name: Fleetfoot Robe
description: Light robe made with a textile material that can magically reduce the wearer weight, enhancing its agility.

name: Staff of the Archmage
description: Powerful staff used by Laroxian mages. Using their extensive magical knowledge, this staff energy source was bound with complex spells into a high-energy state. The crafting process is long and expensive, and they are held only by the most powerful wizards.

name: Orichalcum Helm
description: Made from a metal seemingly impossible to destroy, This helm offers unmatched protection to the wearer.

name: Enchanted Cleaver
description: A cleaver bound with a dense spell compendium, amplifying the force behind every blow.

name: Breathtaking Robe
description:
"A robe made with the wings of a Giant Moth treated to increase the normal amount of choking powder present by several orders of magnitude. Causes swelling in the airways of enemies getting too close, SILENCING them for 2 turns.
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana"

name: Cursed Claws
description:
"Forged from a metal worn by undead beings for unfathomable time, will open a grievous wound on an enemy with the slightest touch. The attack has to be melee for this to happen.
BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge"

name: Banshee Bow
description: Uses two giant claws as the frame, granting extreme flexibility and resistance to tension.

name: Bleak Boots
description: Boots made from unknown materials, glowing with an evil light and blessed by an ancient power.

name: Reassembling Jacket
description: Jacket enhanced with a powerful rune through the manipulation of its ethereal aspect, often achieved using a powerful instrument.

name: Zapper
description: An experimental axe crackling with trapped static, built to dizzy its victims.

name: Ceremonial Cake
description: A grand, multi-layered cake with intricate decorations. Reserved for special occasions like the marriage of a royal, one of these cakes can feed a hundred guests.

name: Primeval Axe
description: An axe of elysian wood and primeval scale, radiating the fury of a forgotten age.

name: Beastmaster Jacket
description: Elite armor embedding several fiery gems. It has a great versatility in combat, and grants increased control on domesticated creatures. Grants Animal Affinity, which increases the damage of living creatures controlled by 1% for each point.

name: Eldritch Mitre
description: This unholy relic amplifies one’s understanding of the universe to extraordinary levels, channeling ancient and forbidden powers.

name: Mutant Jacket
description: Jacket made from a monster mutated through the use of alien technology. Extremely resistant at the cost of a lower mobility.

name: Icicle
description:
"Staff built around an ice magic generator, enhancing the holder's magic with the power of frost.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."

name: Tunica Ignis
description: Slime robe infused with a fiery artifact. Maintains its original properties while granting better control over fire magic.

name: Flying Reaper
description: This flying knife can be thrown to enemies, and recalled with a single gesture.

name: Frozen Embrace
description:
"Enhanced with powerful ice magic, every attacker who touch this armor will be feeling its freezing nature.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."

name: Berserker's Axe
description: A brutal axe wielded by the fierce warriors of the Lost Lands, driving relentless onslaughts.

name: Infernal Chakram
description: The razor-sharp edges of this circular weapon, expertly forged from Infernite, make it lethally effective against enemies at any range.

name: Shield of the Titan
description: An unbreakable shield of unknown making. Forces the holder to feel the sorrow the failed titans in the halls felt, attracting the attention of the surrounding enemies.

name: Orichalcum Armor
description: "Incredibly resistant armor made from Orichalcum, an unbreakable metal. While this material offers the best available protection, It may limit the wearer's mobility."

name: Jeweled Crown
description: Precious crown made with gold with inset emeralds and rubies. Amplifies the magical shielding properties of these stones to provide protection to vulnerable targets, while signalling the high status of the wearer.

name: Cursed Long Axe
description: A long axe steeped in cursed silver and redwood, festering wounds with venom.

name: Cursed Helm
description: Forged from a metal worn by undead beings for unfathomable time, its sharp edges deter any melee attacker, promising devastating wounds to those who dare approach.

name: Unholy Spellcage
description: Bound within this ungodly cuirass by a potent spell, the seal of the Ten Hells burns fiercely, swiftly dissolving any foe bold enough to draw near.

name: Banshee Scream
description: Extremely resistant bow that integrates a piece of alien technology, granting the archer an enhanced ability to hit vital points.

name: Archmage Hat
description: "Extremely powerful, magic-enhancing artifact worn only by Laroxian's Council members."

name: Kabelian Armor
description: Armor donned by the leaders of the Crusade from the Eastern Kingdom, radiating light into the darkest corners of the Realms.

name: Swarmkeeper Armor
description: An ethereal swarm inhabits this armor, and will chew at the flesh of any enemy getting close enough.

name: Sage Jacket
description: Jacket enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.

name: Sage Cloak
description: Cloak enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.

name: Mottiphobia
description: "The blade of this dagger is colonized with small flying critters gathered from an ethereal dream. They will help the holder by swarming a random target, dealing a ranged attack with damage equal to the holder's HP."

name: Wicked Cleaver
description: A cleaver so wicked it slips between worlds, its strikes veering wildly.

name: Duelist Armor
description: "Living armor in a synchronic communication with the wearer's mind, greatly enhancing their reaction times."

name: Sage Armor
description: Armor enhanced with a powerful infusion, able to boost the learning ability of the wearer.

name: Ice Cage
description:
"Incredibly hard and cold armor enhanced with rare reagents from the coldest mountains of the Realm. Will FREEZE attackers on contact.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."

name: Voltaic Shock
description:
"The power of this hook was increased by a core that can amplify and focus the electrical magic simulated within. Will be thrown at a random enemy at the end of the turn, dealing damage and having a small chance to STUN them.
STUN: the unit skips its turn."

name: Cloak of Redemption
description: An intricate pattern made with magic chains is applied on a fire magic enhancing tunic, embedding the wearer in a protective field that reflects a part of the incoming force.

name: Death Ray Scepter
description: "A staff relying on celestial technology that can focus its ray into a thin, but perfectly aimed ray that hits its target with unmatched precision. An unknown device, inorganic but capable of behaving as a living creature, has been integrated in the scepter's mechanism to unlock its true damaging potential."

name: Cunning Downfall
description:
"This armor components can vibrate so fast they disrupt the propagation of sound in the air, making spellcasters unable to cast their spells.
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana"

name: Crushing Depth
description:
"Further enhanced with more refined electrical artifacts and with a string able to withstand extreme weight. Enemies often lose their balance due to the sheer strength of its arrows.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

name: "Slime King's Crown"
description: The crown of the legendary Slime King. Provides a large amount of extra experience to the wearer.

name: Molten Slayer
description: A berserker's axe drenched in infernite, searing every wound it opens.

name: Infernal Long Axe
description: A cursed long axe fused with infernite, poisoning and burning its victims.

name: Abyssal Cutlass
description: A variation of the typical Cutlass, forged using an enhanced metal to make it lighter.

name: Deep Sea Robe
description: The velvet infused with deep sea reagents used in the weaving of this robe confers it enhanced protection against external elements.

name: Deep Sea Jacket
description: Hides processed with reagents gathered in the depth of the ocean, to confer the wearer additional protection against external elements.

name: Stellar Staff
description: Infused with the essence of a distant star, this staff burns hotter than any flame known to this world.

name: Kabelian Claws
description:
"Gloves forged with ancient iron, padded with a metal that shows psyonic capabilities. Vibrates in a way that allows to cut through flesh with extreme ease. The attack has to be melee for the effect to take place.
BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge"

name: Omni-Sever
description: A golden axe imbued with prismatic essence, wielding frost, flame and lightning at once.

name: Tunica Infernalis
description: "Adding a fireproof coating to this unique robe allows to apply different enchantments during its crafting, since protection from it's own fiery power is no longer needed."

name: Amulet of Resurrection
description: Made from the feathers of a legendary bird, in case of death this amulet will resurrect its owner with full HP and no negative effect, possibly forever.

name: Diamond Amulet
description: An elegant amulet adorned with a polished diamond, radiating timeless beauty.

name: Amulet of the Swordsman
description: An amulet that allows the wearer to see through it as if it was an additional eye. Gives a new perspective on the fight, allowing for superior decision making.

name: Cursed Bow
description: Made from a metal displaying unique properties, this bow can be used with a speed unmatched by any other.

name: Captain's Sword
description: A regal blade once carried by the Imperial Captain. Swings with heavy, precise authority.

name: Cursed Scepter
description: A terrible instrument when wielded by the right hands, this unholy weapon will raise walking nightmares from defeated enemies.

name: Absolute Zero
description:
"The coldest material ever forged makes up an armor that not only is incredibly resilient, but will FREEZE enemies on contact.
FREEZE: This unit can't dodge and takes 10 physical damage each turn."

name: Abhorrent Long Axe
description: A long axe anchored with an abiotic core, spreading ruin, fear and silence.

name: Colossal Sword
description: The sword of a colossal titan, too heavy to be held by a common human.

name: Divine Zygote
description: The remains of a being of endless power, who used their last drop of energy to restore its own mortal body into an earlier form. Unable to survive alone, it emanates an energy barrier of unfathomable strength, protecting itself and its keeper from the outside elements.

name: Potion of Clumsiness
description: A liquid brewed through unknown means. Will reset the amount of Potions of Agility drank by an adventurer to zero. This cannot be undone.

name: Seeking Glass
description: A jewel once worn by the Slime King, ensures perfect accuracy under all conditions.

name: Serpent Bite
description: An eldritch artifact from another world. A tangible paradox allowing the holder to blend in more effectively with its surroundings, and allowing them to deal more damage the less they blend in.

name: Serpent Lunge
description: An eldritch artifact from another world. The holder blinks randomly between dimensions, making them difficult for enemies to target.

name: Serpent Staff
description:
"An eldritch artifact from another world. Significantly impairs the holder's control over white magic, but confers a the buff "FRENZY" for 3 turns to every target hit.
FRENZY: This unit deals 30% increased damage."

name: Serpent Sting
description:
"An eldritch artifact from another world. This crossbow generates tensile strength beyond mortal limits. While it delivers massive damage, the recoil STUNS the wielder for one turn after each attack. This effect cannot be cleansed, and ignores immunities.
STUN: the unit skips its turn."

name: XP Book (Tier 3)
description: Grants 1,000 experience to an adventurer.

name: Phylactery
description: An artifact of enormous power, capable of replacing a bound entity in its demise. When held by an unbound entity, however, it greatly boost their ability to regenerate the health of their allies.

name: Mutual Despair
description: Grants a swift demise in skilled hands, demanding a painful toll from its wielder in return.

name: Cosmic Violin
description: A violin as old as time itself, played by ancient horrors during their abject rituals.

name: Sylvan Mandate
description: Infused by divine light, this dagger embodies the will of the forest and grants its holder with the power to enact it.

name: Champion Armor
description: "Further enhanced with part of the soul of the Primordial titan, this armor reached a perfect attunement with the wearer's mind."

name: Infernal Bow
description: The heart of this unique bow has been replaced with Infernite, an exotic material that maintains its shooting speed while enhancing its tensile strength.

name: Pirate King Tricorn
description: Hat historically worn by the highest rank pirate captains, whose thirst for blood is legendary. Made with both regular and enchanted velvet, to provide additional offensive bonuses.

name: Eternal Hunger
description: A powerful, ancient artifact. The wearer will never be sated in their hunger, but will gain the innate ability to consume the physical suffering of their enemies.

name: Infinity Hat
description: "This mysterious headgear came out of a crack in the fabric of space and time. It's both stylish and powerful."

name: Ritual Blade
description: A dull blade, unfit for combat but designed for esoteric rituals to honor the mountain gods. Magically enhanced by the gems embedded in its handle, it grants its wielder healing powers.

name: Cunning Demise
description:
"This armor components, harmonized by a central magical seal to build the most disruptive interference, modifies the properties of the air around to make transmission of sound impossible, hindering spellcasters effectiveness.
SILENCE: the unit can't gain any mana"

name: Invisible Servant
description: "An invisible sphere summoned upon a small altar, once bound to cosmic powers but now loyal to its owner's will. It can carry out simple tasks, protect its master and unleash powerful attacks. Attacks from this source are always ranged, and magic."

name: Divine Embryo
description: Painstakingly fed with a concentrated flow of consciousness, slowly the Ancient God is starting to evolve into another form. It is able to manifest additional powers, granting its keeper a wide range of bonuses.

name: Bloodstone Claws
description:
"Gloves forged with ancient iron, infused with crystalline bloodstone and forged with scarlet debris. Vibrates in a frenzied cadence that allows the wearer to cut through flesh with lethal speed. The attack has to be melee for the effect to take place.
BLEED: the target receives 1 damage at the start of its turn for every charge, then removes one charge"

name: Chief Scientist Coat
description: "An apparently simple coat that belonged to the brightest mind of Kaunis. It increases the wearer attributes in an unknown way that doesn't rely on magic."

name: S.P.I.D.E.R
description: A mechanical set of legs operating on alien technology. Can move the user extremely quick, provide an extra layer of protection for the lower part of the body and will even kick nearby enemies.

name: Prismatic Pendant
description: Powerful trinket containing the essence of all elements. While not very useful in battle, it provides a very large boost to experience gains.

name: Sylvan Blessing
description: The gift of light was bestowed upon this staff, granting it an exponentially higher power and ability to protect allies.

name: Dreadful Morningstar
description:
"A terrible weapon taken from a nightmarish knight. When the holder hits an enemy it has a chance to inflict TERRIFY on them.
TERRIFY: The unit skips its turn and takes 20% max hp as magic damage."

name: Prismatic Armor
description: Combines different types of elemental magic to provide an unbreakable defense, while neutering their individual elemental properties.

name: Infinite Despair
description: Grants a premature end to both the wielder and their enemies.

name: Void Crusher
description: "An enormous sword, so heavy that it can't be lifted by any human. Imbued with the power of darkness, it deals enormous damage."

name: Titanic Might
description:
"Infused with the powder resulted from a successful, albeit unethical, experiment from the Cultist rebels. Every property of this bow has been enhanced, thanks to the unwilling sacrifice of their victims.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

name: Divine Larvae
description: Fed with the flesh of a nightmare beyond comprehension, the new shell of the Hidden God transformed once more, inching closer to its final form.

name: Shield of the Martyr
description: Awakened by the exalted powder gathered from the Primordial, all this shield knows and craves is pain. It will force enemies to attack its bearer at a much higher frequency.

name: Enlighted Servant
description: A spark of light and a drop of darkness were infused in this empty shell, gifting it its very own soul. Having now achieved independent thinking, it is not faster, smarter, and capable of improvising in difficult situations.

name: Celestial Bow
description: A divine celestial bow humming with astral velocity. Allows its wielder to loose a devastating volley of arrows in rapid succession.

name: Void Pendant
description: Enhanced with matter of complementary type, the neutral essence constrained in this amulet was enhanced beyond its natural limits. Provides an extremely large boost to experience gain.

name: Starvation
description: Enhanced with a drop of blood from a legendary individual that sealed the fate of thousand worlds. Inflicts an inconceivable hunger on the wearer, but will allows them to prey even more efficiently on their enemies suffering.

name: Void Armor
description: Not fully understood in its properties, adding a void drop to an already stable mixture of elements seems to further enhance their properties, giving life to the hardest material known to exist.

name: Stellar Flare
description:
"Further enhanced by an ancient, long-forgotten ritual, this bow hits with the strength of a stellar crown's flare.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

name: Robe of the Lich
description: A preserved, ancient robe taken from the cold body of a slain Lich. The blueprints for its making are now lost in time. Grants enhanced powers to the undead caster if its servants are alive.

name: Burning Effigy
description: A powerful symbol of hope for those it protects, and a relentless torment for its bearer. It compels enemies to focus their attention on the holder, who endures the crushing burden of infinite, searing agony.

name: Nil Pendant
description: Perfected with the goo taken from a god of the slimes, this amulet will grant an unmatched learning boost to the wearer.

name: Armor of the Undying
description: A forbidden artifact used to defy death merged with ancient, cursed metal. Serves as a decoy for the life of the wearer, restoring it with an enhanced version of the regular status every time they are hurt.

name: Colossal Sword of Scarlet King
description: A colossal blade steeped in the flesh of the Formless Mother. Bloodflame yet clings to its edge, burning within wounds that refuse to close.

name: Nil Armor
description: An incredibly resistant armor, coated with the flesh of a Slime God. Will grant an unmatched protection to the wearer.

name: Scarlet Sigil
description: An arcane focus intertwining otherworldly eldritch power with the lethal weave of the Scarlet strands. It channels intense occult resonance to fuel endless spellcasting and lethal critical surges.

name: Oblivion
description:
"This unforgiving weapons is imbued with the very essence of darkness. It shoots arrows with unmatched strength, often STUNNING the target it hits.
STUN: the unit skips its turn"

name: Sha
description: Finally awakened with enough time and a strict diet, the Hidden God will serve its owner with utmost loyalty.

name: Scarlet Veil
description: Legends talk about unseen assassins wearing this Veil who were able to take over entire armies. Gifted from an ancient God to allow their worshippers to pursue its goals, only a few shreds of these artifacts exist by now, displaced all around the Realms.

name: Scarlet Oni
description: A demonic visage forged from condensed Scarlet strands. Discarding conventional heavy plating, it surges with raw bloodlust that drives its wearer to strike down foes with brutal, crushing criticals.

name: Scarlet Oni Juggernaut
description: The apex manifestation of demonic Scarlet armor. Imbued with titanic resilience and boundless fury, it pulverizes enemy lines with devastating critical brutality.

name: Scarlet Shroud
description: The legendary Veil, mechanically enhanced using the parts of the mysterious Machine. It autonomously helps the wearer in its movements in a deadly synergy.

name: Aegis
description:
"An ancient artifact of unknown origin, held by the heroes who wish to protect the weak. Will taunt enemies for 2 turns on hit.
TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target"

name: Scarlet Cape
description: A regal cape woven from tenfold Scarlet strands. Flowing with occult grace, it bolsters the wearer's physical and arcane agility while sharpening lethal precision.

name: Eldritch Scarlet Cape
description: The Scarlet Cape steeped in esoteric rites and sealed by outer horrors. Deep crimson threads twist with cosmic energy, multiplying critical destruction.

name: Abyssal Scarlet Mantle
description: An awe-inspiring mantle saturated with Ancestral Blood from the deepest abyss. Its suffocating crimson aura elevates all mortal faculties to mythical heights, delivering cataclysmic critical strikes.

name: Aegis Mechanica
description:
"Enhanced with mechanical parts taken by a mysterious, ancient creature. This unique artifact will change its shape by pressing a small trigger on its hilt, and is able to reach far away targets. Will taunt enemies for 2 turns on hit.
TAUNT: the taunting unit is always chosen as target"

name: XP Book (Tier 10)
description: Grants 100,000 experience to an adventurer.

name: XP Book (Tier C)
description: Grants 1,000,000 experience to an adventurer.
